reconstruction_contract.phase_labels: Active first-endpoint particles are -1, active second-endpoint particles are +1 and inactive capacity slots are zero.
reconstruction_contract.orientation: A weighted least-squares phase gradient is normalized to point from the first endpoint to the second; reversing endpoints reverses every reconstructed normal.
reconstruction_contract.curvature: A second weighted least-squares pass reconstructs the normal Jacobian and emits its trace. A first-material sphere therefore has positive mean curvature and targets 2/R.
reconstruction_contract.support: Both passes use max(first.supportRadius, second.supportRadius) and the P1-05 combined sorted pair index.
reconstruction_contract.finite_bound: Curvature is finite and bounded to 2/min(first.particleRadius, second.particleRadius); non-invertible moments emit zero normal or curvature with a diagnostic flag.
reconstruction_contract.advertisement: No interaction capability record was added or enabled.

bounded_storage.diagnostic_bound: Each endpoint counter is incremented at most once per live particle for its condition and cannot exceed that endpoint count.

physical_fixtures.degenerate_and_empty: One-particle rank-deficient endpoint pairs remain finite and report under-resolved plus degenerate flags. Empty live populations clear all inactive outputs and leave counters zero.
